physics-killer-08.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
physics-killer-08.topic: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
physics-killer-08.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-08.material: I-muon eyenziwe kwindawo ephezulu yomoya womhlaba ibhabha ukuya emhlabeni ngokuthe nkqo ezantsi ngesantya $0.8c$. Ngokunxulumene nomhlaba ubude bendawo yokwenziwa $800\,\mathrm{m}$, kwaye ubomi obuphakathi be-muon obulinganiswe kwinkqubo yayo yokuphumla $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Xa $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa umgama ukusuka kwindawo yokwenziwa ukuya emhlabeni kwinkqubo yokuphumla ye-muon kunye nexesha eliyithathayo ukuhamba lo mgama?
physics-killer-08.thinking.0: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
physics-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: I-muon eyenziwe kwindawo ephezulu yomoya womhlaba ibhabha ukuya emhlabeni ngokuthe nkqo ezantsi ngesantya $0.8c$. Ngokunxulumene nomhlaba ubude bendawo yokwenziwa $800\,\mathrm{m}$, kwaye ubomi obuphakathi be-muon obulinganiswe kwinkqubo yayo yokuphumla $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Xa $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa umgama ukusuka kwindawo yokwenziwa ukuya emhlabeni kwinkqubo yokuphumla ye-muon kunye nexesha eliyithathayo ukuhamba lo mgama?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.explain: $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.8^2}=5/3$. Ukuncipha kobude: $L=L_0/\gamma=800\cdot\dfrac35=480\,\mathrm{m}$. Ixesha $t=\dfrac{L}{v}=\dfrac{480}{0.8\cdot3\times10^8}=2.0\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s}=2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Oku kulingana nobomi obuyiyo be-muon. Umbukeli wasemhlabeni uchaza into enye ngokwandiswa kwexesha: $\Delta t=\dfrac{800}{0.8c}=3.3\,\mu\mathrm{s}=\gamma\cdot2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ukuba uphinda-phinda, $1333\,\mathrm{m}$ (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba kuphindaphindwa $v/c$ endaweni $\gamma$, kuba $640\,\mathrm{m}$ (impendulo engalunganga ②), ukuba ukuncipha kuyalityalwa, ngumphendulo ongalunganga ④.

physics-killer-08.steps.0.prompt: I-muon eyenziwe kwindawo ephezulu yomoya womhlaba ibhabha ukuya emhlabeni ngokuthe nkqo ezantsi ngesantya $0.8c$. Ngokunxulumene nomhlaba ubude bendawo yokwenziwa $800\,\mathrm{m}$, kwaye ubomi obuphakathi be-muon obulinganiswe kwinkqubo yayo yokuphumla $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Xa $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa umgama ukusuka kwindawo yokwenziwa ukuya emhlabeni kwinkqubo yokuphumla ye-muon kunye nexesha eliyithathayo ukuhamba lo mgama?
